# kcore hypervisor

> Declarative virtualization on NixOS: VMs as code, gRPC API, Terraform provider, optional MCP server with the product (not hosted on this domain).

## Read first

- [Documentation hub](https://kcorehypervisor.com/docs.html)
- [User guides](https://kcorehypervisor.com/docs/user/index.html)
- [Product repository](https://github.com/rtacconi/kcore)

## Machine-readable

- [Sitemap](https://kcorehypervisor.com/sitemap.xml)
- [API catalog (RFC 9727)](https://kcorehypervisor.com/.well-known/api-catalog)
- [Agent skills index](https://kcorehypervisor.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json)

## API note

Management plane is gRPC to your controller, not public REST on kcorehypervisor.com. See the repo for `.proto` and design docs.
